reader.requirement: At --std 85 a SYNCHRONIZED elementary item occupies its natural-boundary span exclusively, any unused positions in that span count in the containing group's size and in a REDEFINES of that group but not in a REDEFINES of the elementary item itself; under the implementor determination (every character position a natural boundary, DOC-A.1-195/197) there are no unused positions, so the layout equals the unsynchronized layout.
